learningObjectives: Identify trend, seasonality, and noise in time series data.
Understand the basic workflow for time series forecasting.
Select suitable forecasting approaches for common scenarios.

activities.title: Explore Time Series Components
activities.instruction: Adjust the component level and observe how it can affect a time series.

content.concept: Time series data can contain long-term trend, repeating seasonal patterns, and irregular noise.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Map Forecasting Components
activities.instruction: Explore the role of each component in a forecasting task.

content.concept: Forecasting uses historical observations, time-dependent patterns, and a forecasting model to estimate future values.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Previously observed values used to understand the behavior of the series.
A long-term upward or downward movement in the data.
A pattern that repeats at a known or regular interval.
A statistical or machine learning method used to estimate future values.
The estimated values for future time periods.

activities.title: Build a Forecasting Workflow
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a time series forecasting workflow.

content.concept: A forecasting workflow prepares chronological data, analyzes patterns, trains a model, validates predictions, and produces future forecasts.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

goal: 1. Collect and Order Time Series Data

activities.title: Choose the Forecasting Method
activities.instruction: Match each scenario with a suitable forecasting approach.

content.concept: The appropriate forecasting method depends on the amount of historical data, trend, seasonality, frequency, and complexity of the series.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Simple series with a stable recent level → Moving Average
Series with trend and seasonality → Exponential Smoothing
Autocorrelated time series with suitable historical structure → ARIMA
Complex series with many external predictors → Machine Learning Forecasting
config.answer: Simple series with a stable recent level → Moving Average
